en.T>5cm、腋窝淋巴结阴性：I级胸壁放疗，或胸壁+区域淋巴结放疗。: T>5cm, axillary node-negative: Level I chest wall radiotherapy, or chest wall + regional nodal radiotherapy.

en.乳房切除后是否行胸壁/区域淋巴结放疗，按页面所列cN、ypN及未清扫高危腋窝条件: After mastectomy, stratify the need for chest wall / regional nodal radiotherapy by the page's cN, ypN and undissected high-risk axillary criteria.
en.初始AI满5年、耐受良好且淋巴结阳性/G3/其他需化疗危险因素者：I级继续AI；: After 5 years of initial AI, if well tolerated and node-positive / G3 / other risk factors requiring chemotherapy: Level I continue AI; Level II switch to TAM.
